To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
1) The parasitic capacitance of ESD protection devices should be considered in ESD protection circuit design, especially for high-speed I/0 interfaces.

(a) the parasitic capacitances of the diodes are inversely proportional to their widths; (b) the ESD protection scheme with low-capacitative ESD protection diode is suitable for high-frequency application; and (c) the ESD-protection scheme with the SCR between the pad and VSS has the best ESD protection performance in the PS-mode EDS test
the ESD protection design of the high-speed interface circuits in a CMOS process should consider the parasitic capacitances of the ESD protection devices.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the design of low-capacitace ESD protection devices for high-speed I/0 circuits.
the ESD robust design of high-speed I/O interface circuits in a CMOS process with a 2.5-V/3.3-V power supply.
low capacitance ESD protection for high speed I/O interface.

the proposed ESD protection scheme can provide low-capacitancy and high ESD robustness for the high-speed I/O interface circuits in a standard 1.2-V CMOS process.
the ESD protection design presented in this paper is a low-capacitacnce ESD protection scheme for high-speed input/ouput interface circuits.
the ESD protection scheme for high-speed I/ O interfaces presented in this paper is suitable for the 130-nm high-speed I/O interface design with low-capaci-tance consideration.

we have proposed a low-capacitence ESD protection scheme to improve the EESD level of high-speed I/O circuits in a 1.3-nm CMOS technology.
we have developed a new ESD protection scheme to improve the ESG protection level and reduce the capacitance of the protection device for high-speed I/0 interface circuits.
, with the knowledge of the relationship between the parasitic capacitances of ESD protection devices and their dimensions, a low-capacitence ESD protection design scheme can be developed.

we have demonstrated that the parasitic capacitances of ESD protection diode can be significantly reduced by scaling its dimensions, and the low-capacitances ESD protection design can improve the performance of high-speed interface ICs.
